name: USDGO
oneLiner: USDGO is OSL's yield-bearing Solana dollar issued with Anchorage Digital Bank, passing EFFR-linked reserve yield to holders.
collateral: U.S. Treasuries, cash, and high-quality liquid assets held by Anchorage Digital Bank, with reserve yield linked to the Effective Federal Funds Rate.
pegMechanism: 1:1 USD redemption through Anchorage Digital Bank under U.S. federal oversight

proofOfReserves.provider: Deloitte & Touche LLP via Anchorage Digital Bank

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDGO is publicly described as a U.S. dollar token issued by Anchorage Digital Bank with 1:1 redemption and reserve attestations.

genius.notes: Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. holds an OCC national trust bank charter (granted 2021) and is an uninsured national trust bank — not FDIC-insured and not an IDI subsidiary. Under the GENIUS Act, the federal-qualified-nonbank pathway covers uninsured national banks chartered by the OCC approved to issue payment stablecoins; this is the correct pathway for Anchorage. Anchorage has publicly announced intent to qualify as a PPSI and submitted comment letters to the OCC on the GENIUS Act NPRM, but no PPSI approval or formal application has been submitted — the approval framework is still in proposed-rules rulemaking as of 2026-06-18 (GENIUS Act effective Jan 18, 2027 or 120 days after final rules). No token-specific public OCC GENIUS approval found for USDGO.

mintAuthority.summary: USDGO is a Solana Token-2022 issuer token. C2QJ... is the externally signable mint and permanent-delegate authority; a finalized mint transaction confirms it as the sole on-chain signer. Separate configuration, pause, freeze, and fee-withdrawal EOAs cannot mint. The shared Token-2022 program remains upgradeable through a 4/6 Squads V3 multisig with no enforced delay.

controls.label: USDGO Token-2022 mint and permanent-delegate authority
controls.capDescription: No configured per-mint supply cap; the authority can mint up to Token-2022 integer bounds.
controls.evidence: At finalized slot 432729217 this system-owned, on-curve address was both mintAuthority and permanentDelegate. A successful mintToChecked at slot 432714040 had this address as the transaction's only signer. No address-bound public evidence establishes whether the off-chain key uses MPC or HSM.

controls.label: Solana Token-2022 shared-program upgrade authority
controls.evidence: Token-2022 ProgramData DoU57... named AeLm... as upgrade authority. AeLm... is authority index 1 of Squads V3 multisig BnD53519LK7QM4ERBGvLedZDe1VoTPgtiBkGPWAACiMZ, whose current account data reports threshold 4 and six members. The latest upgrade executed with four recorded approvals. Squads V3 itself is immutable and enforces no timelock.

controls.label: USDGO Token-2022 configuration authority
controls.evidence: System-owned, on-curve authority for metadata, transfer-fee configuration, confidential-transfer configuration, transfer-hook configuration, and mint closure; it is not mintAuthority.

controls.label: USDGO pause authority
controls.evidence: Token-2022 pausableConfig named this system-owned, on-curve address; paused was false.

controls.label: USDGO freeze authority
controls.evidence: The live Token-2022 mint named this system-owned, on-curve address as freezeAuthority; it cannot mint.

controls.label: USDGO transfer-fee withdrawal authority
controls.evidence: The live Token-2022 transfer-fee configuration named this system-owned, on-curve address as the withheld-fee withdrawal authority; it cannot mint.

A successful mintToChecked transaction at slot 432714040 proved the mint authority was the transaction's only signer. Token-2022 ProgramData resolved the shared program upgrade authority to a 4/6 Squads V3 multisig; the latest upgrade executed with four approvals and no enforced timelock.
